messages:
leah: Heads-up — Orchid onboarding is live tomorrow. Early telemetry shows batch ingest + live chat will spike around noon UTC during their import job. renewal sentiment is okay but we want to avoid any noisy tails.

mike: got it. what's the expected qps and typical seq lengths?

leah: import job ~120 r/s for batch/generate with avg seq 300 tokens. chat avg 8 r/s but bursts to 60 r/s.

devin: recommendation: short TTL prefix cache (30s) for identical system prompts, aggressive KV cache for chat, and a small warm pool (warm workers=4) during the 11:50-12:20 UTC window.

hana: for the batch pipeline use batching window=40ms, max_batch_tokens=1536, and enable batching.jitter=0.15. that reduced 95p for a similar dataset. also enable partial_streaming=true for chat so we can deliver first tokens while fallback kicks in. :sparkles:

mike: can you paste the warmup curl so I can schedule it in ops?

leah: paste below — note prefill rate limit to avoid origin throttling. change pref_rate if they have ingress caps.

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/warmup \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RID" \
  -d '{"tenant":"orchid","routes":["/batch/generate","/chat"],"prefill_size":300,"prefill_rate":50}'
```

cs-ops-bot: Warmup job queued: job_id=wm-2025-03-08-orchid-A01 run_at=1746755400

devin: logging/observability checklist: prefill.started/preload.completed, cache.hit_rate, batch.window_ms, batch.size_p50/95/99, stream.latency_first_byte, fallback.count, tenant.tag=renewal_watchlist=false. Also emit a metric: client.backpressure_events.

hana: add an alert: if queue_depth > 75% OR p99 latency > 1200ms for 3m route to fallback model (low_ram_8bit) + enable per-client throttles.

mike: fallback plan noted. who owns rolling the routing policy?

leah: @devin will create a canary policy under Console -> Rollouts -> orchid-prefill-canary and set route rules: priority=primary->quantized if queue_depth>80%.

devin: will do. also adding a short feedback hook: post-onboard email + in-app 2-question pulse at 36h. if NPS <=6 auto-create a support ticket and flag account.owner=leah.

mike: small ask — capture a tag with survey_reason=import_migration so CS can correlate.

leah: done. runbook snippet updated in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CS/Orchid+Prefill+Runbook (link)<-- add details and rollback steps.

cs-ops-bot: Warmup job started: job_id=wm-2025-03-08-orchid-A01 status=running

cs-ops-bot: Warmup job completed: job_id=wm-2025-03-08-orchid-A01 status=success duration=22s prefilled=296 routes=2

mike: metrics look good. cache hit_rate ~82%, batch.p95=310ms, stream.first_byte=95ms. no fallbacks triggered.

leah: excellent. leaving the warm pool for 30 more minutes. follow-up: Hana will draft a brief one-pager for renewal outreach if anything degrades in next week.

hana: on it, will also attach example email and suggested timing windows.

leah: thanks team — closing this thread. please update the Confluence if you hit any edge cases. :raised_hands:
